_comment: Representative wallet set for scripts/perfBenchmark/run.ts. Copy this file to wallets.json (gitignored — never commit real user wallet addresses) and fill in real addresses you have permission to scan repeatedly. A representative set should mix wallet sizes/shapes: a few small/simple wallets (few trades, 1-2 chains), a few dense/heavy-trading wallets, and at least one deep-history wallet, since different pipeline stages dominate for different wallet shapes.
